messages:
María González: hola everyone! María here, joining as an ML infra engineer. excited to be part of Redwood  pronouns she/her. fun fact: I used to brew kombucha. any quick first-week must-dos?
Ethan Park: welcome María :tada: i'm your onboarding buddy. start with laptop & Okta, then request access to ML infra repos. i'll send a short map of repos after standup.
María González: thanks Ethan! are there any preferred local dev tools for model testing?
Rae Chen: welcome! for local testing we mostly use the dev-container with docker-desktop or colima on macs. for heavier models we spin up a dev GPU via infra. i'll DM you the GPU request template.
people-ops-bot: [system] Hola María  Please complete the onboarding survey and upload a headshot: https://hr.redwood.example/onboard
María González: done with the survey. question: where are meeting notes and the team handbook kept?
Ethan Park: team handbook is in the product repo: docs/handbook.md. meeting notes live in the shared Google Drive (link pinned in #eng-runtime).
Rae Chen: also check pinned messages in #eng-ml for eval scripts and the nightly job dashboard.
welcome-bot: [system] Maria added to #eng-ml and #new-hires. Intro call scheduled: tomorrow 10am PT.
María González: perfect. last thing: any local customs? favorite coffee spots?
Ethan Park: if you're near the office, try "Bean & Byte" across the street. team coffee runs on Thursdays.
María González: i'll bring kombucha for the first coffee run :smile: thanks for the warm welcome!
Rae Chen: can't wait to try it. ping me for any onboarding blockers.
